title: RAW UNREVIEWED: qokain/qokaiin as addressee and wearer-role reference across the complete amulet account
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED. In complete f83r.9–17 and f108r.45–47, replace the lexical stipulation YOU=the same wearer by an explicit qokain/qokaiin indexical-versus-role construction. Person identity must be obtained from the written wear instruction and the later SAME WEARER expression; neither a fresh wearer at a paragraph boundary nor an automatic identity alias is licensed.

design.mechanism: Within one instruction episode, qok- denotes a person-reference family; -ain resolves its addressee A, while -aiin resolves the person W filling the declared WEARER role of that episode. A shared imperative-actor binder and the WEAR predicate must decide whether A=W. These are explicit new hypotheses over one paired stem, not a universal suffix translation.
design.unit: Complete GDT1023 P12 f83r.9–17 (84 projected/ZL groups,83 IT) and RAW492 f108r.45–47 (33 ZL,32 IT). All old71+17 guesses, whole-clause outputs and diplomatic conflicts retained as paid-for context.
design.contrast: A discourse indexical and an independently defined role reference versus one hard-coded same-person alias, or a new role occupant at each paragraph.
design.prediction: An unmarked imperative to WEAR by addressee A makes A the unique wearer of the same assembly; the later qokain protection argument then equals W by that event-role relation, not by the lexical meaning of YOU. SAME WEARER in the second paragraph must recover that same role occupant unless a written change intervenes.
design.scope: Conditional C0 authoring of person identity; no real wearing or protection is asserted.

additional_assumptions: qokain=YOU and qokaiin=WEARER are inherited unconfirmed meanings; splitting their shared qok and different minim endings is new.

One addressee binder per full instruction account, one assembly-specific wearer role, and an unmarked imperative actor convention are additional choices. A forward role reference in C03 is allowed before actual wearing, without asserting the action has already happened.
The old qokaiin at C03 already functions as a vocative: role-reference does NOT mean non-vocative and the contrast is not merely grammatical person.

Old YOU was explicitly the same W. With that equality removed from the lexical value, deriving A=W changes the old contract and must be documented as a new C0 version, never literal preservation of all71 meanings.
Old aiin=OF, chkain=PERFORM, dain=BUT and chldaiin=THAT_ASSEMBLY block a universal AIN/AIIN personal-reference rule. The typed-person family boundary is an added cost.
two_discriminating_consequences: The final protection YOU is the one addressee A. If a proposed whole parse assigns engraving/placement to a separate practitioner but leaves the final WEAR command unmarked, the same actor convention determines whether practitioner, wearer and addressee coincide; it cannot choose a different actor per verb merely to fit the story.

At f108r.46 otedy okedy qokaiin (BY SAME WEARER in the old draft), the reference must retain the earlier assembly-specific W across the whole commentary paragraph. A new person at the paragraph boundary cannot satisfy SAME without an explicit identity construction; a new object with a coincidentally equal bird kind is insufficient. These are construction commitments, not new manuscript findings.
strongest_known_countercases: The parent already hard-coded W for engraving, placement, wearing and YOU. No additional identity consequence follows unless the new shared binder actually replaces these clause-indexed assignments.

IDEA417/GDT999 already found no transfer of the fixed Xaiin ykar Xain cheedy frame beyond the seed. Its content/container semantics remain unbound; this person-role offer does not reopen that unchanged frame or generalize all minim pairs.

GDT1038 can pack both complete extension readers under its two permitted atomic/binary choices, but every actual original f83r reader still has gaps. Its success is text packing, not person-reference confirmation.
RAW492 review found the unchanged sequel imposed no new physical consequence; making the same old W visible is not a newly independent discriminator.
Only one qokain/qokaiin paired stem is currently supplied. The old33-group sequel adds qokaiin but no second personal morphology pair.
historical_source: Cyranides I.1.39, complete Greek in T_COMPLETE_UNITS: commands engrave, place, enclose and wear followed by protection addressed to you. This permits a one-addressee account but does not write these Voynich endings or prove who made an actual object. The source date layer is the owned1898 edition of a late-antique/medieval compilation, no passage-specific date certified.

Attempt the whole C03/C06/C08 chain and complete C10–C13 commentary without selecting actors by clause ID. Record every remaining free binder, the exact new costs, and all raw gaps. If the grammar merely looks up the preassigned W, keep this raw; no parser or new participant worlds.
